arxiv-2103-11689.title: Design of slow-light-enhanced bimodal interferometers using dimensionality reduction techniques
arxiv-2103-11689.creator: Luis Torrijos-Morán, Jaime García-Rupérez
arxiv-2103-11689.description: Abstract Interferometers usually require long paths for the ever-increasing requirements of high-performance operation, which hinders the miniaturization and integration of photonic circuits into very compact devices. Slow-light based interferometers provide interesting advantages in terms of both compactness and sensitivity, although their optimization is computationally costly and inefficient, due to the large number of parameters to be simultaneously designed.

arxiv-2112-02500.title: MovieNet-PS: A Large-Scale Person Search Dataset in the Wild
arxiv-2112-02500.creator: Jie Qin, Peng Zheng, Yichao Yan, Rong Quan, Xiaogang Cheng, Bingbing Ni
arxiv-2112-02500.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Jie Qin, Peng Zheng, Yichao Yan, Rong Quan, Xiaogang Cheng, Bingbing Ni. Person search (PS) aims to jointly localize and identify a query person from natural, uncropped images. Existing works unintentionally adopt pedestrians (with similar poses and unchanging clothing) as the query and restrict the application scenarios in surveillance. This is due to that most PS datasets are collected from surveillance cameras with a limited diversity of views, scenes, appearances, etc .

arxiv-2209-01542.title: Recurrent Bilinear Optimization for Binary Neural Networks
arxiv-2209-01542.creator: Sheng Xu 1 †, Yanjing Li 1 †, Tiancheng Wang 1, Teli Ma 2, Baochang Zhang 1,3 ∗, Peng Gao 2, Yu Qiao 2, Jinhu Lü 1,3, Guodong Guo 4,5
arxiv-2209-01542.description: Abstract Binary Neural Networks (BNNs) show great promise for real-world embedded devices. As one of the critical steps to achieve a powerful BNN, the scale factor calculation plays an essential role in reducing the performance gap to their real-valued counterparts.

arxiv-2211-07183.title: Chiral flows can induce neck formation in viscoelastic surfaces
arxiv-2211-07183.creator: E. M. de Kinkelder, E. Fischer-Friedrich, S. Aland
arxiv-2211-07183.description: Abstract During division in animal cells, the actomyosin cortex has been found to exhibit counter-rotating cortical flows, also known as chiral flows, along the axis of division. Furthermore, such chiral surface flows were shown to influence cellular rearrangements and drive the left-right symmetry breaking in developing organisms.

arxiv-2301-09235.title: Learning Reservoir Dynamics with Temporal Self-Modulation
arxiv-2301-09235.creator: Yusuke Sakemi, Sou Nobukawa, Toshitaka Matsuki, Takashi Morie, Kazuyuki Aihara
arxiv-2301-09235.description: Abstract Reservoir computing (RC) can efficiently process time-series data by transferring the input signal to randomly connected recurrent neural networks (RNNs), which are referred to as a reservoir. The high-dimensional representation of time-series data in the reservoir significantly simplifies subsequent learning tasks.

arxiv-2302-11369.title: Direct Optimization of Fast-Ion Confinement in Stellarators
arxiv-2302-11369.creator: David Bindel, Matt Landreman, Misha Padidar
arxiv-2302-11369.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by David Bindel, Matt Landreman, Misha Padidar. Confining energetic ions such as alpha particles is a prime concern in the design of stellarators. However, directly measuring alpha confinement through numerical simulation of guiding-center trajectories has been considered to be too computationally expensive and noisy to include in the design loop, and instead has been most often used only as a tool to assess stellarator designs post hoc.

arxiv-2502-04783.title: Embedding loose trees in k k -uniform hypergraphs
arxiv-2502-04783.creator: Yaobin Chen, Allan Lo
arxiv-2502-04783.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Yaobin Chen, Allan Lo. A classical result of Komlós, Sárközy and Szemerédi shows that every large n n -vertex graph with minimum degree at least ( 1 / 2 + γ ) ​ n (1/2+\gamma)n contains all spanning trees of bounded degree. We generalised this result to loose spanning hypertrees in k k -uniform hypergraphs, that is, linear hypergraphs obtained by subsequently adding edges sharing a single vertex with a previous edge.

arxiv-2502-17321.title: Turning Conversations into Workflows: A Framework to Extract and Evaluate Dialog Workflows for Service AI Agents
arxiv-2502-17321.creator: Prafulla Kumar Choubey, Xiangyu Peng, Shilpa Bhagavath
arxiv-2502-17321.description: Abstract Automated service agents require well-structured workflows to provide consistent and accurate responses to customer queries. However, these workflows are often undocumented, and their automatic extraction from conversations remains unexplored. In this work, we present a novel framework for extracting and evaluating dialog workflows from historical interactions.

pmc-11293134.title: The effect of fear-avoidance intervention on kinesiophobia and self-efficacy in patients after percutaneous coronary intervention: study protocol for a clinical randomized controlled trial
pmc-11293134.creator: Qi Li, Lingjun Yan, Wenhui Xing, Ce Zhou, Yu Li, Boya Wan, Jingjing Piao, Yanmei Gu
pmc-11293134.description: BackgroundKinesiophobia after percutaneous coronary intervention (PCI) may lead to decreased compliance with rehabilitation exercises. Effective interventions are essential to overcome kinesiophobia after PCI. The aim of this trial is to investigate the clinical effects of an intervention based on the fear-avoidance model (FAM) on kinesiophobia in post-PCI patients.

pmc-11359290.description: Glucocorticoids are often used and highly effective anti-inflammatory medications, but prolonged topical application may alter the epidermis’ normal structure and function, potentially resulting in a number of adverse effects. Topical glucocorticoid-induced skin inflammation is a dangerous condition that develops after topical glucocorticoid use.

However, it is uncertain to what extent DC impacts the transmission of vasogenic slow waves and thus the validity and utility of the pressure reactivity index (PRx).

pmc-12596117.title: Hashimoto's thyroiditis and congenital long QT syndrome: a dangerous addition causing torsades—case report
pmc-12596117.creator: Ramesh Acharya, Vaishnavi Sabesan, Deepti Pandit, Dan Schuller, Byomesh Tripathi
pmc-12596117.description: BackgroundHypothyroidism leads to a prolonged QT interval due to modulation of the potassium channel by low circulating T3, leading to a disproportionate lengthening of the action potential. Patients with long QT syndromes (LQTS) have an increased risk of symptomatic ventricular arrhythmias and sudden cardiac death (SCD).

pmc-12717637.title: Research on the Coupled Bionic Design and Validation of Flying Car Folding Wings Based on Eurasian Eagle‐Owl Wing Shape
pmc-12717637.creator: Zhengjun Li, Yuchen Cao, Dehao Zhao
pmc-12717637.description: ObjectiveThis study explores the application of Eurasian eagle‐owl wing characteristics to the design of folding wings for flying cars. uslaw-usc-t6-s121.description: United States Code, Title 6 (Domestic Security); Chapter 1 (Homeland Security Organization); Subchapter II (Information Analysis); Part A (Information And Analysis; Access To Information). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) Intelligence and analysis There shall be in the Department an Office of Intelligence and Analysis. (b) Under Secretary for Intelligence and Analysis (1) Office of Intelligence and Analysis The Office of Intelligence.
